layers.label: Upper-tier municipality (region)
layers.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing (Ontario GeoHub)
layers.caveat: Single-tier cities (e.g. Toronto) have no upper tier; regional rules then do not apply.

layers.label: Lower or single-tier municipality
layers.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing (Ontario GeoHub)
layers.caveat: Municipal boundaries decide which DC, fee and zoning by-laws apply.

layers.label: Greenbelt Area
layers.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Municipal Affairs and Housing (Ontario GeoHub)
layers.caveat: Outer boundary only: Protected Countryside, Oak Ridges Moraine and Niagara Escarpment designations inside it differ.

layers.label: Conservation authority jurisdiction
layers.publisher: Ontario Ministry of the Environment, Conservation and Parks (Ontario GeoHub)
layers.caveat: Jurisdiction only. Whether the site is inside the regulated area (valleys, floodplains, shorelines) needs the authority's own regulation mapping.

layers.label: Major transit station area (Minister-approved)
layers.caveat: Toronto only. Inclusionary zoning also needs the IZ market area (not published as open data) and is paused until 2027-07-01.

layers.label: Secondary plan
layers.caveat: Toronto only. Secondary plan policies override parent Official Plan designations for height, density and uses.

layers.label: Site and Area Specific Policy (Official Plan)
layers.caveat: Toronto only. Read the policy text: SASPs can add or remove permissions.

layers.label: TTC subway: within 60 m (technical review)
layers.caveat: Subway centrelines from 2019: Lines 5 and 6 and the Ontario Line are missing, and 60 m is measured from the line, not from structures or entrances.

layers.label: Historic treaty area
layers.caveat: Treaty boundaries are approximate and do not define rights, interests or consultation obligations. Speak with the Nations named here.

layers.label: Aerodrome within 6 NM (aeronautical review screen)
layers.caveat: A screen, not the Airport Zoning Regulations: AZR height surfaces are registered regulations without open GIS. Within 6 NM, or taller than about 100 ft near an airport, expect NAV CANADA and Transport Canada filings for the building and cranes.

unavailable.label: Inclusionary zoning market areas (Toronto)
unavailable.why: Published as a map on toronto.ca, not as open data. IZ is paused until 2027-07-01.

unavailable.label: Conservation authority regulated areas (TRCA, CLOCA)
unavailable.why: Regulation limits are kept by each authority.

unavailable.label: Airport Zoning Regulation surfaces (Pearson, Billy Bishop, Oshawa)
unavailable.why: Registered regulations with plan drawings; no open GIS.

unavailable.label: Zoning by-law (Toronto 569-2013, Oshawa 60-94)
unavailable.why: Toronto publishes zoning GIS but it is large and must be read with the by-law text; Oshawa zoning is not published as open data.

unavailable.label: Durham Region and Oshawa secondary plans and Official Plan designations
unavailable.why: Durham ROP layers exist on maps.durham.ca with mixed licensing; Oshawa layers not found as open data.

unavailable.label: Area-specific development charges and community improvement plans
unavailable.why: Defined in by-law schedules, not open GIS.
